scope: Source-owned constant-coefficient spherical finite-volume diffusion, real positive Rosenbrock shift, identity mass

implemented.complexity_per_application: 4 passes over every latitude with O(N) work; serial action uses output scratch only
implemented.independent_reference: scipy.sparse.linalg.spsolve on a periodic block-diagonal matrix

adaptive_driver.current_contract: Protected JVP-only driver sets the identity preconditioner. The source-owned latitude operator cannot be recovered from an opaque JVP.
adaptive_driver.next_change: Introduce an explicit opt-in factory on the typed spherical problem and an adaptive matrix-free driver entry that receives the factory. Build P from the current attempt's sigma=gamma*h, reuse across its stage solves, charge setup and applications, pass it through every GMRES branch; retain the underlying unpreconditioned true-residual check.
adaptive_driver.rollback: Rebuild on any changed shift or geometry identity including a rejected attempt; discard unconfirmed stage state. A failed candidate can retry with the protected identity preconditioner from the same accepted checkpoint within the original work budget.
qualification: Align RHS, Jacobian action, PI parameters, stage threshold, and output schedule with the protected route; verify final time, error, true residuals and rejection accounting.
Include nonzonal/multimode data; compare native identity GMRES, line-GMRES with both column policies, a separable direct solve and sparse external time solvers at matched achieved error.
Report Fourier setup or recurrence setup, O(N) work, preconditioner applications, end-to-end wall distributions, peak memory, finite factor validation and serial-versus-parallel crossover.
Test sigma=0, zero diffusivity, polar rings, wrong grid, nonfinite/negative shift, geometry changes, rejection with a new h, and explicit fallback with no leftover recycle state.
Use weighted SPD/PCG bounds only for this symmetric diffusion class. Retain identity/other routed solvers on nonnormal advection or mixed source terms until a separate argument and holdouts exist.
